name: KEMIS Learner Register
description: Writes the school's learner register as a CSV file for the Kenyan national education management information system, with the UPI, the learner's details, the class, the admission number and the guardian contact.
author: SchoolPilot

settings.label: Institution code
settings.description: The school code as printed on the school's KEMIS record

settings.label: Include guardian contacts
settings.description: Fill in the guardian name, relationship and phone; the columns stay in the header either way

settings.label: Start the file with a byte-order mark
settings.description: Excel needs it to read the file as UTF-8; turn it off if the portal rejects the leading bytes
